title: Summit Right of Rescission and Funding — Compliance Standard
content:
Every Cedarline Summit Proprietary Reverse Mortgage loan carries the federal right of rescission. A Summit loan is boarded to servicing in its rescission period, and from there it either becomes rescinded or funds and becomes active.

## 1. The standard

1.1 Rescission business days count every calendar day except Sundays and federal legal public holidays, starting the day after the closing date.

1.2 A Summit rescission is honored only when the borrower's notice is given no later than the last rescission business day of the period that starts at the loan closing and lasts the plan's rescission period (3 rescission business days under every Summit plan).

1.3 Without a timely notice the loan funds on the next rescission business day after the period and becomes active.

## 2. The evidence

The clock starts from the closing date shown on the loan record for that loan; the loan record, not the borrower's recollection, fixes the closing date. The notice must relate to the same Summit loan whose closing date is used. The last rescission business day is itself inside the period: a notice given on that day is timely, and a notice given on any later day is not.

## 3. Counting the period

| Step of the count | Rule |
|---|---|
| Starting point | the day after the closing date |
| Days counted | every calendar day except Sundays and federal legal public holidays |
| Saturdays | counted |
| Length | the plan's rescission period in rescission business days |
| Notice deadline | no later than the last counted day, that day included |
| Funding without a timely notice | the next rescission business day after the period |

## 4. Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, a 3-day period)

- **Closing on a Friday, no federal legal public holiday in the following days.** Saturday is day 1, Sunday is not counted, Monday is day 2 and Tuesday is day 3. A notice given on Tuesday is honored; a notice first given on Wednesday is not. Without a timely notice the loan funds on Wednesday and becomes active.
- **Closing on a Thursday, a federal legal public holiday on the following Monday.** Friday is day 1, Saturday is day 2, Sunday and the Monday holiday are not counted, and Tuesday is day 3. A notice given on Tuesday is honored; without a timely notice the loan funds on Wednesday.
- **Closing on a Monday, no holiday that week.** Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday are days 1 to 3. A notice given on Thursday is honored; on Friday it is not, and absent a timely notice Friday is the funding day.
